features: Expiratory flow bias during oscillations to improve secretion clearance
Closed circuit design with an Aerogen® Solo nebulizer and built-in controller
Dual air-path control to separate inhaled and exhaled air
Advanced therapy programming to customize each therapy
Store up to 10 therapy profiles with customizable names
Touchscreen control and intuitive user interface
Lightweight system is only 9 lbs, including the lithium-ion battery
A lithium-ion battery is included with each system, supporting up to 10 therapies (10-minute therapy on a new, fully charged battery)

Oscillating lung expansion (OLE) therapy: positive expiratory pressure (PEP), high-frequency oscillation (HFO) and nebulization combined in a 10-minute therapy (therapy time may differ with patient needs and ordered therapies)
Patient interfaces: face mask, mouthpiece or trach adapter; may also be used in-line with a ventilator in acute care settings

In-vitro (bench) results reported by ABM: up to 3x more expiratory flow with high-frequency oscillations, and up to 4.5x more aerosol than a leading OLE system. In-vitro results do not establish clinical outcomes
